verdict.rationale: Docs mention that issues can be browsed and resolved (via MCP investigate-errors flow) and that GlitchTip aims for Sentry API compatibility, implying standard triage actions, but there is no explicit evidence of assigning an owner, ignoring, snoozing, or automatic reopening of a resolved issue on regression. missing for 10: explicit documentation of assign-owner workflow, ignore/snooze mechanics, and automatic reopen-on-regression behavior.
